title: brachyglottis bellidioides
intro: Brachyglottis bellidioides, commonly known as New Zealand button bush, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family and is native to New Zealand. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Brachyglottis bellidioides include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
